manifest.description: Enables tenant-level UI customisation. When enabled, the agent can help users design and build a completely custom frontend that replaces the default chat UI, while talking to the same backend APIs.
panel.draft.empty: No draft yet. Ask the agent to build a custom UI — it will write to _tenant/shell/.
panel.draft.ready: Agent has written a shell draft. Preview it below, then publish to go live.
panel.published.live: Custom shell is live for all users of this tenant.
panel.published.empty: No published shell yet. Publish a draft to replace the default UI.
panel.workflow: Workflow: Agent writes draft → preview here → publish to go live. Each tenant has its own shell.
